PREREQUISITE_TOOL_MISSING.remediation: Install or expose the pinned release tool before retrying.

INPUT_MISSING.remediation: Provide the complete create-only promotion input set.

INPUT_UNSAFE.remediation: Replace symlinked, non-regular, or group/world-writable inputs.

INPUT_INVALID_JSON.remediation: Regenerate the malformed report from its authoritative producer.

UNRESOLVED_PLACEHOLDER.remediation: Build and sign real release artifacts; source-checkout placeholders cannot be promoted.

REPORT_NOT_VERIFIED.remediation: Resolve the producing gate instead of editing the report by hand.

SOURCE_REVISION_MISMATCH.remediation: Regenerate every report and artifact from one exact source revision.

CURRENT_MATERIAL_DIGEST_MISMATCH.remediation: Regenerate policy, SBOM, action-lock, and supply-chain evidence together.

ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.remediation: Investigate the divergent build or artifact; do not re-sign mismatched bytes.

EMPIRICAL_SUITE_INELIGIBLE.remediation: Resolve empirical contradictions or missing happy-path evidence in the canonical lab.

ATTESTATION_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Restore GitHub attestation verification and rerun against the exact subjects.

ONLINE_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Restore the public registry or advisory service; an unavailable audit is not a clean audit.

PROMOTION_OUTPUT_EXISTS.remediation: Choose a fresh create-only output path; never overwrite a prior decision.

PROMOTION_POLICY_REFUSAL.remediation: Repair the failed policy input; do not weaken the policy to obtain promotion.

INTERNAL_ERROR.remediation: Preserve the refusal report and fix the deterministic promotion tooling.
